title.narrative: Strengthening the National Trust Eco-Fund's Financing and Implementation Capacity

description.narrative: " Mobilizing financing for environmental protection and climate change action is one of the priorities of the current Bulgarian government, and thus an emerging priority of the new CPS (under preparation. Despite significant needs and a tight fiscal situation, one of the major current constraints to resource mobilization, especially from the EU and other donors, is the country's capacity to prepare bankable projects, to see them through the application and approval process, and to support their implemetation through monitoring and evaluation. The National Trust EcoFund (NTEF - The Fund) was established in 1995 for the administration of the funds provided through a mechanism for conversion of Bulgaria's debt into environment protection projects. Over the years the Fund has played an important role in the area of ""Debt for Environment Swap""), but is need of significant strenthening in order to play the broader role assigned to it by the current GoB, that of mobilizing international funding for environmental protection and supporting implemetaion of the countries environmental and climate chnage policies. The development objective of the proposed IDF grant is to strengthen the institutional capacity of the Bulgarian National Trust EcoFund (NTEF) to help increase the absorption of international financing from EU and other donors, and to coordinate the implementation of internationally funded projects, consistent with Bulgarian national environmental and climate change policies and priorities. The grant to be executed by the National Trust EcoFund will support the follwoing activities: (i) Developing a new strategy and action plan for the period 2012-2020, to position NTEF as an efficient resource mobiliztion and financing institution on the European scene, in the area of environmental management and green investments; (ii) Technical support for the management of NTEF, including improved rules and procedures for for project selection, evaluation, and monitoring & evaluation; and (iii) Training of staff and improving the information management capacity of NTEF. FUNDING: Once the IDF is approved, the CMU will provide a standard annual supervision budget (currently 15k/FY). TF099613 The development objective of the proposed grant is to strengthen the strategic planning, management, and technical capacity of the Bulgarian National Trust EcoFund (NTEF), which will result in: (i) improved capacity to identify and appraise (GHG emissions-reducing) projects to be financed through the selling on the international carbon market of the country's 290 million Assigned Amount Units (carbon credits); (ii) improved quality of project proposals and documentation required for EU financing; and (iii) increased participation in the EU Emissions Trading Scheme."
